title: LibScript Database Inventory Schema
description: Schema validating detected or active database services and instances on the host system

version.description: Version string extracted from binary or greeting packet

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the database service (e.g. '127.0.0.1')

socket.description: UNIX domain socket path or Windows named pipe

service_name.description: Windows service name or systemd/rc.d unit name

is_active.description: Boolean status indicating whether daemon is currently running and responsive

source.description: Discovery mechanism or probe that identified this instance

items.description: Name of an existing database schema or keyspace

existing_schemas.description: Array of pre-existing database schema names hosted by this instance
